proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.peering_through_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing surface can model a charge-based magic-item activation, a 10-minute duration, and a truesight grant, but it cannot truthfully express that the sense is available only while the user peers through the item during that duration. `holding_item` is too broad and would overgrant the effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

notes: Do not author a placeholder record. The honest fit is blocked by a missing gating variant on the granted sense, not by a missing top-level magic-item family.
